1.title: Trump’s Posts on Singing Somali Schoolchildren Stir Anger in Minnesota
1.summary: The state’s large Muslim and Somali communities expressed indignation after the president reposted a video of a kindergarten promotion ceremony, including comments noting the girls were in hijabs.

2.title: White House Directed Patel to Oversee Investigation Involving Times Reporting
2.summary: The F.B.I. director spent about eight hours at the White House Friday focused on the effort, which led to the subpoenaing of several Times reporters who wrote about the security of Air Force One.

3.title: At Vigil, Sons of Man Killed by ICE in Houston Call for Accountability
3.summary: The sons of Lorenzo Salgado Araujo recalled their father’s love of soccer and said they would “continue to keep fighting for him.”

4.title: Polish PM pledges memorial to victims of WW2 'genocide by Ukrainian nationalists'
4.summary: Warsaw and Kyiv have for decades been at loggerheads over the killings of many thousands of civilians during World War Two.

5.title: Iran supreme leader calls for revenge for father's killing
5.summary: Mojtaba Khamenei says vengeance is "inevitable" for the killing, which happened on the first day of the US-Israeli war on Iran.

6.title: U.S. Citizen Tests Positive for Ebola in Democratic Republic of Congo
6.summary: The American, who works for the humanitarian organization Samaritan’s Purse, is the second to be infected in an outbreak that continues to spread.
